continuation_strategy.rationale: T000006 validated 25 records and T000007 validated 50 records through the same guarded production workflow. T000008 increases the scientific review tranche to 100 records while retaining explicit human scientific approval and separately tracked one-use live authorization.

purpose: Define the third generic post-pilot screening tranche after successful completion of T000007. T000008 doubles the proven 50-record tranche to 100 records. This artifact freezes target identity and operational boundaries only and contains no scientific screening decisions or live mutation authority.
